text:
When aluminium is placed in dilute hydrochloric acid, there is no reaction.
When zinc is placed in dilute hydrochloric acid, bubbles of gas are immediately given off.
Which statement correctly explains these observations?
A
Aluminium is coated with a layer of aluminium oxide.
B
Aluminium is more reactive than hydrogen.
C
Aluminium is less reactive than zinc.
D
Zinc is less reactive than hydrogen.

options.label: A
options.text: Aluminium is coated with a layer of aluminium oxide.

options.label: B
options.text: Aluminium is more reactive than hydrogen.

options.label: C
options.text: Aluminium is less reactive than zinc.

options.label: D
options.text: Zinc is less reactive than hydrogen.
